note: Enntity/atlas inkling2/mini-20261121: the Inkling 2 Mini (model type inkling2_loop) serving series, 36 commits on Atlas-Inf main 269b533bc (Merge #332). It parses the checkpoint as 48 unrolled layer visits, checks its layout at load, and adds the inkling-2-mini kernel target: decode attention with relative bias and per-token sinks, short convolutions with verify rollback, block attention residuals, loop message gates, NVFP4 and MXFP8 stacked-expert MoE decode, prefill experts at the checkpoint's declared numerics (W4A4 / W8A8 on the block-scaled tensor cores), GQA flash prefill attention, CUDA-graph single- and multi-sequence decode, the Spark NVFP4 overlay (attention projections, the experts of layers 20-23, lm_head), and the checkpoint's DSpark drafter on the DFlash head. Prefix caching is refused (conv states are not snapshotted); no vision tower. Proposed upstream to Atlas-Inf.
